def hydra(q, k, v):
    """
    q, k, and v should all be tensors of shape
    [batch, tokens, features]
    """
    q = q / q.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    k = k / k.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)

    kv = (k * v).sum(dim=-2, keepdim=True)
    out = q * kv

    return out
